features.name: Posted ESG reporting lines API
features.description: New API endpoint with get method to access posted ESG reporting lines. Enables export of CSRD and other compliance reporting data to external ESG reporting tools or compliance platforms.
caveats: Requires Power Platform license for native Microsoft integration

features.name: Sustainability value entry API
features.description: New API endpoint with get method for sustainability value entries. Allows external systems to access carbon footprint data created from purchase, sales, and production documents for reporting or analysis.

features.name: Sustainability purchase line API
features.description: New API with get, post, and patch methods for purchase lines. Enables integration with external software for carbon footprint calculations directly on purchase lines and import of emission data.
caveats: Designed for integration with external software

features.name: Sustainability goals API
features.description: New API with get, post, and patch methods for goals. Allows integration of goals configured in external third-party software with Business Central for unified tracking.

features.name: ESG sales invoice layouts
features.description: Two new report layouts for posted sales invoices showing carbon equivalent information per line item and total carbon footprint in kilograms to expose sustainability metrics to customers.

features.name: ESG sales quote layouts
features.description: New report layouts for sales quotes showing carbon equivalent per unit and total carbon footprint to help customers see sustainability impact when sending quotes.

features.name: Product classification item card field
features.description: New field on item card enabling integration with external product classification sources. Supports UNSPSC standard to populate carbon footprint and emission factor data automatically.
caveats: OABL e-document integration enabled for Denmark as pilot

features.name: Carbon tracking method field
features.description: New field on item sustainability fast tab enabling choice between average and specific carbon costing methods. Specific method provides more accurate carbon footprint tracking using item tracking.
features.status_evidence_quote: You have new field carbon tracking method and this is currently in a public preview.
caveats: Specific method requires item tracking for serial numbers or lot numbers
Average method remains default to prevent breaking changes
Only one tracking method can be selected per item

features.name: Specific carbon costing method
features.description: New carbon costing method option providing more accurate carbon footprint tracking compared to the default average method. Works similarly to specific item costing.
features.status_evidence_quote: And this is currently in a public preview.
caveats: Requires item tracking enabled on items
Requires serial numbers or lot numbers
